6	 * subprocess. This module is the SINGLE place the pipeline shells out to

236:Only `scripts/agent.ts` runs acquisition. It extracts articles, scans live updates, writes files, updates the catalogue, and creates logs. It fails before browser or DB startup on unknown commands, unknown options, missing option values, invalid dates, invalid providers, invalid tags, and invalid numeric values.
291:- Every new article persist, live-posts replace (rescan), and revision bump (`scripts/refresh.ts`) automatically (re)builds that one article's chunk rows: span chunks over the current revision's body for regular articles, one chunk per `live_posts` row for live updates.
